name.en-US: Spiritual Letters to One of His Converts
name.pt-BR: Cartas Espirituais a Um de Seus Convertidos

description.en-US: Extracts from Benson's letters (1915) to one of his converts, in six parts: Anglican letters, early Catholic letters, letters from Rome, letters of spiritual direction, to one beginning a literary career, and to one entering religion.
description.pt-BR: Trechos das cartas de Benson (1915) a um de seus convertidos, em seis partes: cartas anglicanas, primeiras cartas católicas, cartas de Roma, cartas de direção espiritual, a quem inicia uma carreira literária e a quem entra na vida religiosa.

sources.edition: Spiritual Letters to One of His Converts (London: Longmans, Green, 1915), Internet Archive full-text OCR (spiritualletters00bensuoft).
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1915, so the text is public domain.

title.en-US: V. To One Beginning a Literary Career
